excluded_attempts.reason: Before the fix, four semantic cases failed from wrong literal category, one progressive fixture used unsupported source-free streaming, and one nullable-source category control passed. The progressive fixture was changed to a supported one-row table; expected values were retained. This exploratory six-test version predates the additional concatenation test.

Seven new integration tests passed, but an older non-NULL static-declaration control exceeded default depth16. The accepted retry explicitly requests existing depth32 for that semantic fixture; production depth limits were unchanged.
One-test diagnostic identifies the older nested scalar/Variant source expression that reaches StructureLimit at default depth.

depth_control_note: Both pre-feature frozen CLIs refuse the same non-NULL nested expression with default/explicit16 and succeed with explicit32. The semantic fixture uses the supported option; expected result and runtime limits are unchanged.
